card.name: Punctuation and links in immune-risk passages
card.fires_on: Commas, linking words and symbols just before a list or value in text on immune deficiency, infection risk or lab thresholds. Examples are "limited to<<,>>", "include", "caused by" and "<" before a cell count.

modes.label: Comma or verb before a list
modes.description: Comma or verb introducing a list of immune deficiencies or conditions.
modes.example: The primary immune deficiencies to be studied include, but are not limited to<<,>> autoimmune polyendocrinopathy candidiasis

modes.label: Link word before a risk term
modes.description: Small words such as by or with leading into infection or malignancy risk.
modes.example: especially those caused<< by>> encapsulated bacteria, such as Neisser

modes.label: Symbol in lab thresholds
modes.description: Decimal point or less-than sign inside a lab count or limit.

card.plain: It fires on small punctuation and linking words that come right before a list of infections, immune conditions or lab limits.
